name: x2611_11287_thm1_4
statement:
(n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
Asymptotics.IsBigO Filter.atTop (fun H : ℕ => (H : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * Real.log (H : ℝ)) (fun H : ℕ => (x2611_11287_exceptional_count n (H : ℤ) : ℝ)) ∧
Asymptotics.IsTheta Filter.atTop (fun H : ℕ => (x2611_11287_exceptional_count 3 (H : ℤ) : ℝ)) (fun H : ℕ => (H : ℝ) ^ (4) * Real.log (H : ℝ))
closed:
∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n), Asymptotics.IsBigO Filter.atTop (fun H : ℕ => (H : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * Real.log (H : ℝ)) (fun H : ℕ => (x2611_11287_exceptional_count n (H : ℤ) : ℝ)) ∧
Asymptotics.IsTheta Filter.atTop (fun H : ℕ => (x2611_11287_exceptional_count 3 (H : ℤ) : ℝ)) (fun H : ℕ => (H : ℝ) ^ (4) * Real.log (H : ℝ))
original: For $n\geq 3$ , we have $C_{n}(H)\gg H^{n+1}\log H$ . Furthermore, we have $C_{3}(H)\asymp H^{4}\log H$ .
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), 3 ≤ n → ((fun H => ↑H ^ (n + 1) * Real.log ↑H) =O[Filter.atTop] fun H => ↑(Mathlib2.x2611_11287_exceptional_count n ↑H)) ∧ (fun H => ↑(Mathlib2.x2611_11287_exceptional_count 3 ↑H)) =Θ[Filter.atTop] fun H => ↑H ^ 4 * Real.log ↑H

lemma x2611_11287_thm1_4_aux1 {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (P : Matrix ι κ ℤ → Prop) (H : ℤ) :
    {A : Matrix ι κ ℤ | (∀ i j, |A i j| ≤ H) ∧ P A}.Finite := by
  have hrow : {f : κ → ℤ | ∀ j, f j ∈ Set.Icc (-H) H}.Finite :=
    Set.Finite.pi' (fun _ => Set.finite_Icc _ _)
  have hall : {A : ι → κ → ℤ | ∀ i, A i ∈ {f : κ → ℤ | ∀ j, f j ∈ Set.Icc (-H) H}}.Finite :=
    Set.Finite.pi' (fun _ => hrow)
  apply hall.subset
  intro A hA i j
  exact abs_le.mp (hA.1 i j)

lemma x2611_11287_thm1_4_aux2 {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (P : Matrix ι κ ℤ → Prop) :
    Monotone (fun H : ℕ => Set.ncard {A : Matrix ι κ ℤ |
      (∀ i j, |A i j| ≤ (H : ℤ)) ∧ P A}) := by
  intro H K hHK
  apply Set.ncard_le_ncard _ (x2611_11287_thm1_4_aux1 P (K : ℤ))
  intro A hA
  exact ⟨fun i j => (hA.1 i j).trans (by exact_mod_cast hHK), hA.2⟩

lemma x2611_11287_thm1_4_aux3 (n : ℕ) (R E : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hE : Monotone E) (hbound : ∀ H, H * R H ≤ E (2 * H))
    (hR : Asymptotics.IsBigO Filter.atTop (fun H : ℕ => (H : ℝ) ^ n * Real.log (H : ℝ))
      (fun H => (R H : ℝ))) :
    Asymptotics.IsBigO Filter.atTop (fun H : ℕ => (H : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * Real.log (H : ℝ))
      (fun H => (E H : ℝ)) := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hcR⟩ := Asymptotics.isBigO_iff'.mp hR
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hcR
  apply Asymptotics.IsBigO.of_bound (2 * (3 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * c)
  filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (2 * (N + 3))] with H hH
  have hqN : N ≤ H / 2 := by omega
  have hq3 : 3 ≤ H / 2 := by omega
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (H / 2 : ℕ) := by positivity
  have hHpos : (0 : ℝ) < H := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < H by omega)
  have hHq : (H : ℝ) ≤ 3 * (H / 2 : ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show H ≤ 3 * (H / 2) by omega)
  have hHsq : (H : ℝ) ≤ ((H / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    have hq3' : (3 : ℝ) ≤ (H / 2 : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast hq3
    nlinarith
  have hlog0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (H : ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ H by omega))
  have hqlog0 : 0 ≤ Real.log ((H / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ H / 2 by omega))
  have hlog : Real.log (H : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.log ((H / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [Real.log_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] using Real.log_le_log hHpos hHsq
  have hpow := pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg H) hHq (n + 1)
  have hr := hN (H / 2) hqN
  simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, Nat.abs_cast, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hq0 _) hqlog0)] at hr
  have hcmp : ((H / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * R (H / 2) ≤ E H := by
    exact_mod_cast (le_trans (hbound (H / 2)) (hE (by omega : 2 * (H / 2) ≤ H)))
  have hrq := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr hq0
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ'] at hrq
  have htarget : (H : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * Real.log (H : ℝ) ≤
      (2 * (3 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) * (((H / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * Real.log ((H / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (3 * ((H / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ (n + 1) *
          (2 * Real.log ((H / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) :=
        mul_le_mul hpow hlog hlog0 (pow_nonneg (by positivity) _)
      _ = _ := by rw [mul_pow]; ring
  have hresult : (H : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * Real.log (H : ℝ) ≤
      (2 * (3 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * c) * (E H : ℝ) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (2 * (3 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) * (c * (((H / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * R (H / 2))) := by
        apply htarget.trans
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
        nlinarith [hrq]
      _ ≤ (2 * (3 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) * (c * E H) := by gcongr
      _ = _ := by ring
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, Nat.abs_cast,
    abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg H) _) hlog0)] using hresult

lemma x2611_11287_thm1_4_aux4 (n : ℕ) (R E : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hbound : ∀ H, E H ≤ (6 * H + 1) * (R (4 * H) + 1))
    (hR : Asymptotics.IsBigO Filter.atTop (fun H : ℕ => (R H : ℝ))
      (fun H => (H : ℝ) ^ n * Real.log (H : ℝ))) :
    Asymptotics.IsBigO Filter.atTop (fun H : ℕ => (E H : ℝ))
      (fun H => (H : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * Real.log (H : ℝ)) := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hcR⟩ := Asymptotics.isBigO_iff'.mp hR
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hcR
  apply Asymptotics.IsBigO.of_bound (7 * (2 * c * (4 : ℝ) ^ n + 1))
  filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (max N 4)] with H hH
  have hH4 : 4 ≤ H := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hH
  have hHN : N ≤ 4 * H := by omega
  have hH1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ H := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ H by omega)
  have hHpos : (0 : ℝ) < H := by linarith
  have hlog1 : 1 ≤ Real.log (H : ℝ) := by
    rw [← Real.log_exp 1]
    apply Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1)
    exact Real.exp_one_lt_three.le.trans (by exact_mod_cast (show 3 ≤ H by omega))
  have hlog0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (H : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hlog : Real.log (4 * (H : ℝ)) ≤ 2 * Real.log (H : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (ne_of_gt hHpos)]
    have hFourH : (4 : ℝ) ≤ (H : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hH4
    have := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 4) hFourH
    linarith
  have hlog40 : 0 ≤ Real.log (4 * (H : ℝ)) := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hr := hN (4 * H) hHN
  simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, Nat.abs_cast, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat,
    abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4 * H) _) hlog40)] at hr
  have hpow1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (H : ℝ) ^ n := one_le_pow₀ hH1
  have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (H : ℝ) ^ n * Real.log (H : ℝ) := by nlinarith
  have hr' : (R (4 * H) : ℝ) + 1 ≤
      (2 * c * (4 : ℝ) ^ n + 1) * ((H : ℝ) ^ n * Real.log (H : ℝ)) := by
    have hterm : (R (4 * H) : ℝ) ≤
        (2 * c * (4 : ℝ) ^ n) * ((H : ℝ) ^ n * Real.log (H : ℝ)) := by
      calc
        _ ≤ c * ((4 * (H : ℝ)) ^ n * Real.log (4 * (H : ℝ))) := hr
        _ ≤ c * ((4 * (H : ℝ)) ^ n * (2 * Real.log (H : ℝ))) := by gcongr
        _ = _ := by rw [mul_pow]; ring
    nlinarith
  have hE : (E H : ℝ) ≤ (6 * (H : ℝ) + 1) * ((R (4 * H) : ℝ) + 1) := by
    exact_mod_cast hbound H
  have hresult : (E H : ℝ) ≤ (7 * (2 * c * (4 : ℝ) ^ n + 1)) *
      ((H : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * Real.log (H : ℝ)) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (6 * (H : ℝ) + 1) * ((R (4 * H) : ℝ) + 1) := hE
      _ ≤ (7 * (H : ℝ)) * ((2 * c * (4 : ℝ) ^ n + 1) *
          ((H : ℝ) ^ n * Real.log (H : ℝ))) := by gcongr <;> linarith
      _ = _ := by rw [pow_succ]; ring
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, Nat.abs_cast,
    abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg H) _) hlog0)] using hresult

theorem x2611_11287_thm1_4 (n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    Asymptotics.IsBigO Filter.atTop (fun H : ℕ => (H : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * Real.log (H : ℝ))
      (fun H : ℕ => (x2611_11287_exceptional_count n (H : ℤ) : ℝ)) ∧
    Asymptotics.IsTheta Filter.atTop (fun H : ℕ => (x2611_11287_exceptional_count 3 (H : ℤ) : ℝ))
      (fun H : ℕ => (H : ℝ) ^ 4 * Real.log (H : ℝ)) := by
  have hRank : ∀ m : ℕ, 2 ≤ m →
      Asymptotics.IsTheta Filter.atTop (fun H : ℕ => (x2611_11287_rank_count m 1 (H : ℤ) : ℝ))
        (fun H : ℕ => (H : ℝ) ^ m * Real.log (H : ℝ)) := by
    clear n hn
    sorry
  have hLower : ∀ m : ℕ, 3 ≤ m → ∀ H : ℕ,
      H * x2611_11287_rank_count m 1 (H : ℤ) ≤
        x2611_11287_exceptional_count m ((2 * H : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
    clear n hn hRank
    sorry
  have hUpper : ∀ H : ℕ,
      x2611_11287_exceptional_count 3 (H : ℤ) ≤
        (6 * H + 1) * (x2611_11287_rank_count 3 1 ((4 * H : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1) := by
    clear n hn hRank hLower
    sorry
  have hmono (m : ℕ) : Monotone (fun H : ℕ => x2611_11287_exceptional_count m (H : ℤ)) := by
    exact x2611_11287_thm1_4_aux2
      (fun A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℤ =>
        m < x2611_11287_centralizer_dim (A.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)))
  have hlo (m : ℕ) (hm : 3 ≤ m) :=
    x2611_11287_thm1_4_aux3 m
      (fun H => x2611_11287_rank_count m 1 (H : ℤ))
      (fun H => x2611_11287_exceptional_count m (H : ℤ))
      (hmono m) (hLower m hm) (hRank m (by omega)).isBigO_symm
  refine ⟨hlo n hn, ?_, hlo 3 (by omega)⟩
  exact x2611_11287_thm1_4_aux4 3
    (fun H => x2611_11287_rank_count 3 1 (H : ℤ))
    (fun H => x2611_11287_exceptional_count 3 (H : ℤ))
    hUpper (hRank 3 (by omega)).isBigO
